name: BambooHR
summary: HR software for small and medium businesses.

flows.title: Request time off
steps: Sign in. A company's BambooHR opens on its own subdomain of bamboohr.com.
Go Home and click Request Time Off in the Time Off widget. If it is not there, the HR team has to grant that access.
Enter the date or dates, select a time off category, and enter how much time off. It defaults to one day's hours, or one day, and to zero on a company holiday.
Enter a note about the request. The future balance list shows each category's balance on the request's first day.

flows.title: Change or cancel a time off request
steps: Go to the Time Off tab, hover over a future request in the Upcoming Time Off section, and click the edit button that appears.
Or, in the time off history table, select the category, click Requests, and click the status link beside the request.
Change the date, category, amount or note and click Save, or click Cancel Request if the time off is no longer needed.
An employee can edit a request only while it is in the future. A request in the present or past is updated by an administrator.

flows.title: View time off history
steps: Go to the Time Off tab.
Select the time off category to show in the History table.
Pick a year from the year drop-down, or All for every year.
Choose the subtable for balance history or for requests. The Upcoming Time Off table lists upcoming requests, approved and denied, and company holidays in the next 60 days.
